title: Swedish Medical LLM Benchmark: development and evaluation of a framework for assessing large language models in the Swedish medical domain

paper.repo_license: none at repo root (benchmarks/pubmedqa/LICENSE is PubMedQA's MIT; README mentions CC BY only for the paper)

dependence.note: The benchmark's results table is the LLMs' accuracies on 2,665 Swedish medical questions; the ranking claim (GPT-4-turbo / Claude-3.5 / o3 top) is entirely model output.

claim.statement: 'GPT-4-t' (GPT-4-turbo; repo result files show gpt-4-0125-preview) achieved the top SMLB weighted score, 75.57% (+/- 0.76) - PQ-S 53.90 (+/- 1.58), SMDT 79.07 (+/- 1.73), EM 93.10 (+/- 1.18), GM 93.09 (+/- 0.98) - ahead of Claude-3.5 (October) 75.20 and o3 73.58, with several models passing the SMDT doctors' test (>60) (Table 5, Figure 1; Conclusion).
claim.metric: accuracy (%) per sub-benchmark; SMLB = question-count-weighted mean over 2,665 items; standard error via Miller (2024) with clustering for SMDT follow-ups; single run
claim.original_source: Table 5 (Performance of LLMs on the SMLB); Figure 1; Conclusion section 5 ('GPT-4-turbo: 75.57%'); repo results/results_whole_gpt_4t.json (PQ-S, model gpt-4-0125-preview), results/results_gp_gpt_4.json and results_emergency_medicine_gpt-4.json (model gpt-4-0125-preview, run 2024-09-03)

protocol.model: gpt-4-0125-preview (per the repo's result files; the paper only says 'GPT-4-turbo' / 'GPT-4-t')
protocol.model_note: The scaffold's live arm 'gpt-4-turbo' is an alias false positive: the paper never names a snapshot, and the stored runs used gpt-4-0125-preview (api_models.py also sets gpt_model = 'gpt-4-0125-preview').
protocol.model_status: DEAD - gpt-4-0125-preview shut down 2026-03-26. Live proxy: gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (dying 2026-10-23).
protocol.endpoint: litellm completion() -> OpenAI chat completions (single user message)
protocol.prompt_source: run_llm/api_models.py (Swedish system prompts per benchmark, e.g. PQ-S: 'Du aer en utmaerkt laekare och skriver ett laekarprov ... svara med endast ett av: ja, nej, eller kanske'; SMDT: '... Svara med hela svarsalternativet ...') composed by run_llm/benchmark_set_up.py final_prompt_format(); paper Appendix A

params.other: 3 s sleep between calls; responses lower-cased and lexically matched (detect_answers); malformed answers counted as wrong

protocol.evaluation: Automatic: per-benchmark detect_answers() string matching against ground truth (full option text expected), accuracy via evaluate_performance.py; SMLB = weighted mean; error bars per Miller (2024)

artifacts.data_license: PQ-S source PubMedQA MIT; Swedish exam material licence not stated
artifacts.redistributable: unknown (Swedish medical exam questions' copyright not stated)
artifacts.notes: results/ contains gpt-4-0125-preview runs for PQ-S (1000), GM (666), EM (464) but no SMDT run; api_models.py currently defaults MODEL_NAME to gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17.

blockers: live model dead: the GPT-4-t runs used gpt-4-0125-preview (shutdown 2026-03-26); the paper's 'GPT-4-turbo' label hides this
temperature unset (default 1.0) and a single run - original numbers carry sampling noise beyond the reported SE
Swedish exam items' copyright/redistribution unstated; EM/GM 'test' variants are GPG-encrypted (key not public)
SMDT raw result file for gpt-4-t is absent from the repo, so item-level comparison is only possible for PQ-S, EM, GM

successors: llama-3.x (open weights, hash-pinned; paper used Llama 3/3.1 70B)

budget.assumptions: CONDITIONAL proxy run: 2,665 items x 3 seeds; input ~250 (PQ-S), ~700 (SMDT), ~300-320 (EM/GM) tokens incl. Swedish prompt; output <= 40 tokens (max_tokens 10/200).

judgment.rule: ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 (proxy): survival if SMLB weighted accuracy lies within 75.57 +/- 2 x 0.76 (and each sub-benchmark within +/- 2 SE) and the sub-benchmark ordering EM ~ GM > SMDT > PQ-S is preserved; the cross-model ranking (GPT-4-turbo >= Claude-3.5 >= o3) needs successor arms and is judged by direction only.
judgment.notes: PQ-S is label-imbalanced ('yes' bias) and the authors call it the least reliable sub-benchmark; consider judging on SMDT+EM+GM as a sensitivity analysis.

user_checks: Accept gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 as proxy for the dead gpt-4-0125-preview (the paper never names the snapshot; only the repo result files do)?
Core claim = SMLB total (75.57) as drafted, or the SMDT-only 'passes the Swedish doctors' test' figure (79.07)?
Confirm redistribution status of the Swedish exam items with the authors (bmoell@kth.se) before archiving prompts+items in our logs.
domain_notes: PQ-S is a GPT-4-translated PubMedQA (yes/no/maybe) with a strong 'yes' label imbalance - older models score higher by answering 'yes', newer ones lower - so PQ-S differences do not track medical competence. SMDT items are long Swedish clinical exam questions (avg ~1,500 chars, 5 options); EM/GM come from specialist exams with follow-up questions clustered per case and are near saturation (~93-97%). Answer parsing is lexical (the full option text is expected), so output-format drift across model versions can move scores independently of knowledge.
